instruction.text: Find the fronted adverbial in the sentence below.

end.text: Fronted adverbials are words or phrases that go at the beginning of a sentence. They describe the action in the sentence that follows.

atoms.a: Next week, I will go to Spain.
atoms.b: ((Next week)), I will go to Spain.

instruction.text: Find the fronted adverbial in the sentence below.

atoms.a: Behind the houses, you can see wind turbines.
atoms.b: ((Behind the houses)), you can see wind turbines.

instruction.text: Find the fronted adverbial in the sentence below.

atoms.a: Nervously, Rosie waited to see the dentist.
atoms.b: ((Nervously)), Rosie waited to see the dentist.

instruction.text: Find the fronted adverbial in the sentence below.

atoms.a: Twice a week, we play basketball together.
atoms.b: ((Twice a week)), we play basketball together.
